473: Less than a kezayit (the size of an olive) - because with a kezayit there is a doubt about an after bracha, if you should bless or not, therefore it is better to eat less than a kezayit so there will not be an obligation according to everyone.
(55) And he blesses ‘borei Pri Haadaama - and he should intend to exempt with this blessing also the bitter herbs that he will eat afterwards (later authorities/achronim)
